scientific_integrity: The all-size covariance and threshold proofs use the path recurrence and an exact continuant identity. The finite census checks every labelled graph and every pair through order five, with an executable exact-integer checker; independent audit is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform positive fugacity; endpoint pair on finite fans only; no claim of full graph-family covariance classification or thermodynamic phase transition. The exhaustive graph minimum concerns at most five vertices. Indexed literature comparison is bounded; historical priority and independent scientific validation remain unconfirmed.
title: A sharp five-site covariance reversal and a parity threshold on hard-core fan graphs
